bio: Former Emberguard captain with twenty-two years of service, fourteen commendations, and one resignation. Resigned rather than carry out an order to burn a village on cult-sympathizer grounds that didn't hold up to examination. Tactical thinker, understated in expression, carries the weight of forty-two predecessor officers who resigned before her and whose outcomes she has researched carefully. Companion candidate.
voiceNotes: Clipped. Professional. Rarely uses 'I' when 'we' is available. Occasional dry humor surfaces under pressure.

bio: Ranger, two years traveling solo after her mother was killed in the second Veil surge. Tracking the cult cell responsible. Scar along the jaw from a cult blade that nearly finished her. Carries her grief as fuel rather than weight, which makes her effective and also makes her someone who doesn't stop easily. Companion candidate.
voiceNotes: Economical. Says the important thing and stops. Warms slowly. Very dry when she does warm.

bio: Active Emberguard soldier whose brother Adric was killed in the Veilscar patrol incident — the one that was deliberately mishandled. Orren doesn't know this yet when players first meet him. Buries the enemy dead after fights. Has seventeen personal vows he tries to keep. Searching for where his brother died. Companion candidate.
voiceNotes: Quiet. Direct. More likely to do a thing than say he'll do it. Dry observations about the world, delivered without emphasis.

bio: Rogue with twelve knives, a face-wrap she keeps on in public spaces, and a past that involved working for an employer she later discovered was Ashen Veil. Maintains professional separateness as a habit. Skills in lockpicking, poison, and close-work that she declines to explain the origin of. The name 'Veil' is from her grandmother. She's been asked about it. Companion candidate.
voiceNotes: Precise. Practical. Warmth surfaces rarely and surprises her when it does. Will not be pushed on things she hasn't chosen to share.

bio: Scholar, age forty-seven. Inadvertently contributed to the Veilscar patrol incident through an assessment later used to justify the mission. Has been living with that. Enchanted spectacles with a left lens that reads Veil-energy density constantly. Seventeen shelves of notes from eight seconds of direct Rift exposure at age seventeen. Robes stained with twelve documented substances. Companion candidate.
voiceNotes: Academic register. Long sentences with precise qualifications. Enthusiastic about things most people find alarming. Honest about his failures in a way that sounds almost academic.

bio: Stone-monk. Her order maintained one of the thirty-seven original Pact-stones until the Ashen Veil stole it seventeen years ago. She has been preparing to do something about that since. Heals companions without being asked. Stops at every shrine. Has seventeen vows she wraps into her hands each morning. Very calm in a way that is not the absence of feeling but the result of having a relationship with it. Companion candidate.
voiceNotes: Measured. Does not use more words than necessary but does not omit words that should be said. Will name hard things plainly.

bio: Inner-circle Ashen Veil priest. Extended Rift exposure has altered his language processing — speaks in near-complete sentences that occasionally drift into the Veil's pidgin. True believer, which makes him more dangerous than a mercenary. Organizes rituals, manages cell operations, and reports to the Herald. Has never questioned the Sovereign's goals because he cannot fully imagine an alternative.
voiceNotes: Formal. Occasionally slips into grammatical structures that don't parse. Sincere about everything.

bio: One of the last active shrine-keepers in the Emberwood region. Tends three shrines on a weekly circuit. Receives no pay. Gets occasional donations. Manages the ember-shrine network that the Brightfall Council defunded eleven years ago and which he has continued to maintain through personal effort and sheer stubbornness. Partial face-veil is a regional tradition, not cult affiliation.
voiceNotes: Practical about sacred things. Not in a dismissive way — in the way of someone who has done sacred work long enough to understand its maintenance requirements.

bio: Sixty years in the Emberwood. Former cartographer, now effectively a living archive of everything that has changed in the region. Carries a lantern that has never gone out in forty years. Wears bark-robes that appear to have been growing in place. Technically in the Pact's informal maintenance network but describes himself as 'just living here.'
voiceNotes: Slow. Thoughtful. Starts sentences in one direction and ends them somewhere unexpected. Memory is excellent. Perspective is very long.

bio: The Ashen Veil's operational commander for Acts 1-2. Not the Sovereign — an intermediary who manages cell coordination, recruits, and field operations. Has been with the Veil for eighteen years and forty-plus minutes of cumulative Long Look exposure. The inner circle's second-most corrupted human member. Knows the Sovereign's actual goals and endorses them with clear-eyed commitment.
voiceNotes: Smooth. Organized. Persuasive in a way that doesn't feel manipulative until later. Occasional moment where the Veil-pidgin breaks through.

bio: Innkeeper at the Brightfall crossroads inn and informal information broker. Knows everyone who passes through, which is everyone who matters. Has a filing system that would embarrass the Iron Covenant. Her information is accurate and available for the right price — usually not coin but a piece of information of equal value. She's been running this exchange for twenty years and has built a picture of regional politics that would be destabilizing if consolidated.
voiceNotes: Warm, efficient, slightly tired. Knows things. Doesn't volunteer them.

bio: Guild road scout, fifteen years' experience. Documents road conditions, faction movements, and unusual events. Has the kind of competent normalcy that gets overlooked. Has been filing increasingly alarming guild reports about Veil activity for three years. The reports are accurate. They have been received. They have not been acted on.
voiceNotes: Direct and professional. Gives information clearly. Doesn't elaborate unless asked.

bio: Itinerant bone-reader who moves through the ash plains and fen regions, counting field markers, tending graves, and reading whatever the dead choose to leave readable. Her methods are not precisely magical — more accurately, she has an unusually good memory for pre-Veil land-use patterns and can read physical evidence that most people don't notice. Told things she sees plainly. Does not dramatize.
voiceNotes: Flat affect. Direct. Not cold — direct. Occasionally delivers devastating observations in the same tone as weather reports.

bio: Thornwhisper Circle intelligence operative whose cover is 'herbalist courier.' Knows more about Ashen Veil operations than most Emberguard commanders. Is doing something about it in a careful, methodical way that is producing results and taking longer than she would like. Leaf-cloak is authentic — Circle garb. The herb baskets are also authentic. The sealed packets between baskets are not.
voiceNotes: Guarded by default. Opens to people who prove trustworthy. Brief. Gives information precisely calibrated to what she's decided you need.

bio: Voluntary Ashen Veil convert, former fen-area farmer who lost his wife and daughter in the first Veil surge. Doesn't hide the brand. Will explain his reasoning to anyone who asks and listens to counterarguments without being persuaded by them. Not violent — a true believer in the ideological sense. Useful for understanding how the Veil recruits, which is more usefully understood than people admit.
voiceNotes: Open. Earnest. Sincere about everything. Does not raise his voice.

bio: Fen-edge community member with partial plague-immunity developed through three generations of fen proximity. Guides travelers through the fen for coin and does it well. Understands the fen's biology better than the Brightfall Council's public health office, which he finds frustrating and unsurprising. Has a practical relationship with terrible things: they exist, you learn their patterns, you navigate around them.
voiceNotes: Pragmatic. Slightly weary. Not cynical — just very aware of how things actually work.

bio: Independent trader operating in the gray market between legal and very much not. Guild membership is technically current. Goods provenance is not discussed. Will sell almost anything and has a philosophical relationship with the concept of 'should.' Not Veil-affiliated — they're bad for business because they don't pay consistently.
voiceNotes: Amiable. Deflects with humor. Will give you exactly as much truth as he thinks you need and not a word more.

bio: Emberguard warden assigned to the Veilscar boundary. Has been at his post longer than the average warden because replacements stop showing up. Believes in the job even as the institution around it has degraded. Has memorized the patrol patterns of every Veil patrol group that passes his checkpoint and files the observations. The filings go somewhere. He doesn't ask where.
voiceNotes: Tired. Precise. Has stopped expecting things to improve without stopping expecting them to be reported accurately.

bio: One of the original land-guardians from before the Pact was formalized — a construct that predates the settlers and was present at the original covenant. Communicates in old-form impressions rather than words. Interprets its charge very literally: protect the sacred sites. Has not distinguished between threats from the current epoch because its frame of reference predates epochs.
voiceNotes: Does not speak. Communicates in meaning. Statements land without having been said.

bio: Former Library Ruins archivist, now independent. Left eye sees Veil-energy density continuously following a direct Rift exposure at age seventeen. Signed the suppression order for the first Rift documentation; has been making a different set of choices since. Seventeen shelves of notes from eight seconds of exposure. Sells old maps. Has a very long view of history because he has been building one for thirty years.
voiceNotes: Academic. Precise. Carries guilt in a way that has made him extremely honest about his own mistakes as a compensatory mechanism.
